paragraphs: On Friday after school, Lily and Mom went to the bus station. They wanted to visit Grandma and Grandpa in Green Hill tomorrow. The station was big and busy. A woman sat at the ticket window. Lily stood in front of the window and spoke first. "Excuse me, how much is a ticket to Green Hill?"

"It is forty baht for your mom," said the woman. "For you, it is twenty baht, because you are a child." "Two tickets for tomorrow morning, please," said Mom. "What time does the bus leave?" "There is a bus at eight o'clock and another at ten o'clock," said the woman. "We take the early bus," said Mom. "Then we can have lunch with them." "That is sixty baht," said the woman. Mom gave her a hundred baht, and the woman gave back forty baht.

"Which way is the bus?" asked Lily. "Go over the bridge and turn right," said the woman. "The bus for Green Hill stops at stop three." "It is in front of a small shop." "Thank you," said Lily and Mom. Lily looked at the bridge and the stops. Then she looked at the ticket in her hand. "Stop three, eight o'clock," she said. "I can find it tomorrow."

On the way home, Mom looked at the sky. It was winter, and the evening was cool. "The nights in Green Hill are cold in winter," said Mom. "Bring a jacket," she said. "We get our bags ready tonight." "Can Pip come with us?" asked Lily. "No, he stays with Dad and Tom," said Mom.

At home, Lily put her jacket and a book in her bag. She put the tickets in the front pocket. Pip sat on the bag and looked at her. "You must stay here, Pip," said Lily. "But I can bring you a story from Grandpa." Pip said, "Woof!"
text.summary: Lily and Mom buy two bus tickets to Green Hill at the bus station. A woman tells them the price, the time, and the way to the bus, and at home Lily packs her bag.
